title: Ext groups of $\mathcal O_X$-modules
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme and $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ be
$\mathcal O_X$-modules. The *Ext groups* are the right derived
functors of the contravariant functor
$\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(-,\mathcal G)$:

$$
\operatorname{Ext}^i_X(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)
:=R^i\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(-,\mathcal G)(\mathcal F)
$$

on the abelian category of $\mathcal O_X$-modules; in particular
$\operatorname{Ext}^0_X(\mathcal F,\mathcal G) =\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)$.
lead_note: Blueprint error (reviewer R-elf, 14:40 UTC): Ext^i_X(F,G) is defined as right derived functors of the contravariant Hom(-,G) on O_X-modules, which has no enough projectives; the correct definition (Stacks Cohomology, section "Ext groups", cohomology.tex line 10995) is R^i Hom_{O_X}(F,-)(G) via injective resolutions of G, or RHom in D(O_X). The split must state the definition that way and name the correction (E7).
